profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Monarch Quantum
profile.summary:
I am a current graduate student at the Georgia Institute of Technology, working towards an M.S. in Computer Science. I am also an alumni of the University of California, San Diego where I graduated with my B.S. in Aerospace Engineering.

I have a deep passion for the following topics: software development, data analysis, design and analysis of aero-structures. I pride myself on working efficiently and effectively to accomplish tasks at hand, all while being able to be integrated into teams that hope to accomplish the common goal that we are striving for.

Lastly, I would like future employers to know that I truly do enjoy being a life-long learner. I believe knowledge is one of the fundamental keys to progress in one's personal and professional career. This is one of the main reasons I will continue to educate myself in various subjects through academia.

Skills: MATLAB, Python, Java, C#, C++, CATIA V5, SolidWorks, Siemens NX, Siemens Femap, Excel, Git, Linux, SQL, HTML5/CSS3, Jira, Statistical Analysis, Data Visualization, Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Supported a program at Naval Information Warfare Pacific (NIWC) related to cryptographic software, with efforts in analysis, development, testing, and integration of software within an Agile Scrum development environment. Developed software, in a Linux Virtual Machine (VM), that aligns with specifications and requirements via the Qt framework with QML (Qt Modeling Language), C++, CMake, YAML, Bash scripting, SQLite, and Catch2 unit tests. Reviewed and generated code merge requests in GitLab which include use cases, manual test procedures, and PlantUML generated sequence diagrams for Software Design Document (SDD) revisions. Participated in Agile sprint ceremonies and demonstrating newly developed software features to customers.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Qt · QML · Gitlab · VersionOne

positions.title: Digital Signal Processing Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Matlab · Python · C++ · C# · Data Visualization

positions.title: Aerospace Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Aided the E2C2 Structures Fleet Support Team (FST) with sustainment efforts on structural components pertaining to US Navy E-2C, E-2D, and C-2A aircraft. Provided structural repair instructions related to damaged structures in a timely manner. Developed MATLAB and Excel-based scripts/forms to streamline metallic and composite repair analysis.
positions.insights: Skills: FEMAP · Matlab · Structural Analysis · Composite Structures · 2D CAD Drawing

positions.title: Associate Engineer - Program Quality
positions.description: Introduced to Quality methodologies such as Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) and Production Parts Approval Process (PPAP). Interfaced with individuals at different Collins sites to obtain status of the varying PPAP elements for their assigned parts. Held meeting that included Quality manager to give summary overview of past weeks updates that the team had accomplished.

positions.title: Associate Engineer - 787 Design
positions.description: Implemented engineering change proposals as part of the 787 Sustainment Design group. Acquired knowledge of change notice documentation and ability to interpret 2D detail and assembly level drawings. Assisted in designing ply drop-off regions for repair using the Generative Shape Design workbench within CATIA V5.

company.name: University of California, San Diego - Jacobs School of Engineering

positions.title: Engineering Student, Senior Design Wing Stress Analysis Lead (SE 143A/B)
positions.description: Programmed MATLAB code that analyzed for normal and shear stress along the proposed composite wing span subject to predicted aerodynamic load distributions. Designed SolidWorks lofted wing surface geometry from data points given in Excel file and generated lofted curved wing box spar from data points given by MATLAB code. Assembled components of proposed UAV concept design in SolidWorks and rendered product using SolidWorks PhotoView 360 workbench.

positions.title: Engineering Student, Design of Composite Structures (SE 142)
positions.description: Learned about fiber and matrix properties, micromechanics, stiffness, and ply-by-ply stress. Introduced to wet-layup and VARTM procedures and manufacturing simple structures using them. Programmed MATLAB scripts to compute composite properties, lamina stiffness and strength behavior, laminate stiffness and stress subject to applicable loads, and minimum margin of safety derived from First Ply Failure analysis. Earned 1st place with teammates in class-wide composite sandwich beam 3 point bending competition.

positions.title: Research & Design Engineering Intern
positions.description: Generated preliminary mechanical designs of various mandrels to help aid in trapped tooling process. Produced programs with MATLAB to analyze macroscopic mechanical properties of  composite laminates. Developed initial procedure to determine max deflection of components during cure cycle via ABAQUS.

positions.title: Mechanical Team - Design Engineer
positions.description: Drafted the concept AUV, single-hull torpedo design, in SolidWorks that was accepted by our sponsors at the Scripps Institute of Oceanography. Designed and 3D printed a propeller with 3 blades for the software team to test their side thrusters. Tested for air leaks using a vacuum pump and integrated cable penetrators to assembly.

positions.title: Research & Design Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created an iterative program using MATLAB to solve for optimal angles subject to two-dimensional shock wave analysis. Produced preliminary supersonic body designs in CATIA V5 and generated assembly motion with DMU Kinematics. Conducted flow simulation analysis with STAR CCM+ on different CAD models to validate MATLAB output.

positions.title: New Member Project - Entry Level Engineer
positions.description: Learned to design and simulate rockets in OpenRocket software to analyze preliminary models. Constructed a 3 inch diameter, 34 inch long solid-fuel rocket integrated with a K-class motor. Built the swept fins by modeling them in AutoCAD and then used a laser cutter to cut out the plywood fins.
